overview: Each Senate committee needs approval for its operating budget, and this resolution, written by the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation, requests that budget for March 1, 2025, through February 28, 2027. That committee oversees areas such as transportation, telecommunications, consumer protection, and science and space programs. It would cap the committee's spending at $6,259,693 for March through September 2025, $10,730,903 for the fiscal year running October 2025 through September 2026, and $4,471,210 for October 2026 through February 2027, paid from the Senate's contingent fund, with smaller limits on spending for outside consultants and staff training. It also allows the committee to hire staff and, with approval, use staff from federal agencies. On February 19, 2025, it was referred to the Senate Committee on Rules and Administration, which reviews committee budgets; the Senate later approved overall committee funding in a separate combined resolution (S. Res. 94).
for: Supporters say the committee covers a very wide range of industries and agencies and needs adequate staff and funding to oversee them.
against: Critics say committee budget requests deserve close review as spending on Congress itself, and the amounts are set with little public debate.
